purpose: Define IAM as the composition boundary joining stable IdentityCore identity, authentication/assurance, PortfolioCore evidence references and MeritCore competence history without collapsing those domains into one model.

topics.name: IAM Composition
topics.purpose: Define IAM as the composition boundary joining stable IdentityCore identity, authentication/assurance, PortfolioCore evidence references and MeritCore competence history without collapsing those domains into one model.

semantics.identity_rule: IdentityCore identity is the stable cross-component anchor.
semantics.portfolio_rule: PortfolioCore remains owner of references/evidence metadata.
semantics.merit_rule: MeritCore remains owner of merit, points, Tier, recommendations and trust.
semantics.auth_rule: Authentication/assurance proves the current caller/session context but does not redefine identity.
semantics.access_rule: AccessCore consumes IAM identity/assurance context but remains the authorization owner.
semantics.composition_rule: IAM references component semantics rather than duplicating them.
semantics.projection_rule: Combined IAM/profile views are projections over component-owned semantics.

invariants.rule: IAM composes identity, authentication/assurance, PortfolioCore and MeritCore references while preserving each component's ownership; AccessCore authorization remains orthogonal.

hard_gates.condition: IAM duplicates component-core semantics as new ownership
IAM itself becomes AccessCore authorization owner
combined profile projection becomes source of truth

references.purpose: IdentityCore is IAM's stable identity anchor.

prose.summary: Define IAM as the composition boundary joining stable IdentityCore identity, authentication/assurance, PortfolioCore evidence references and MeritCore competence history without collapsing those domains into one model.
